name: bala-perdida
description: Monorepo de Bala Perdida (Cliente React + PixiJS v8 y Servidor Colyseus + Matter.js)

scripts.install:all: (cd server && npm install) && (cd client && npm install)
scripts.dev: bash -c 'trap "kill 0" EXIT INT TERM; (cd server && npm run dev) & (cd client && npm run dev) & wait'
scripts.build: (cd server && npm run build) && (cd client && npm run build)
